title: Loop Call Head Position Bound
statement: Let $\mathrm{body}$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $\mathrm{anchor}$ be a state of $\mathrm{body}$, and let $x$, $s$, and $\mathrm{word}$ be Boolean words. For a configuration $\mathrm{fuel}$ of $F$ on $x$ and a natural number $B$, suppose every work-tape head of $\mathrm{fuel}$ lies in the integer interval $[-B,B]$. Then every work-tape head of the loop-call configuration built with startup flag false, the seam configuration at state $\mathrm{anchor}$ from the tape words assigning $s$ to tape zero and empty words to the other body tapes, release flag true, no flag symbol, $\mathrm{word}$, and $\mathrm{fuel}$ also lies in $[-B,B]$.
hypotheses_covered: Every work-tape head of $\mathrm{fuel}$ lies between $-B$ and $B$
